So this place is called ‘La Deliziosa’, let’s break that down; although this is a Spanish name, but I will take the liberty to interpret the first word from Arabic; ‘La’ in Arabic means ‘No’ and ‘Deliziosa’ means ‘Delicious’ in Spanish, so naturally the restaurant is aptly named “NOT DELICIOUS” Pizza!
We ordered 3 Pizzas, Shawarma, BBQ & Tikka.
Mind you all, Tikka was barely bareable, the rest were just absolutely unbelievably BAD! I’m not even exaggerating, they added cabbage as topping on the Shawarma Pizza!!! CABBAGE!!?? Who adds Cabbage as dressing/topping for anything? It was raw Cabbage! It was just unbelievable! (Attached pictures for reference)
On top of all this, the menu advertised 25% Fazaa discount. The menu already had slashed prices, but nowhere did it mention that those were Fazaa prices. When I availed for discount, the lady at the reception said the prices are already discounted and gave me AED 2 off on each pizza, saying most customers who eat are all Fazaa members, so when I asked her what do the non-Fazaa people pay? She said the same slashed prices! This just did not make any sense!
Imagine you go to a restaurant, see the slashed prices on the menu (assuming they are for all) (also the menu did not mention that it was a fazaa menu or special menu) and order accordingly, and when you go to pay, since you are not a fazaa member, you have to pay the non-slashed full prices! How ridiculous is that? Absolutely Pathetic Experience! Would not recommend one bit!
the taste exceeded my expectations, specially the Chicken Ranch Pizza! pasta is good too! highly recommended if u like italian style!
